description: This file defines the AppRunnerClient class in the Aws\AppRunner namespace, extending AwsClient. It contains method annotations for interacting with AWS App Runner services, including methods for creating, describing, deleting, and listing resources, as well as managing domain associations and autoscaling configurations. The class acts as a client interface for Amazon Web Services' App Runner service within the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: AppRunnerClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with AWS App Runner service, providing methods to manage App Runner resources.

methods.name: associateCustomDomain
methods.description: Associates a custom domain with an App Runner service.

methods.name: createAutoScalingConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a new auto scaling configuration for App Runner.

methods.name: createConnection
methods.description: Creates a new connection resource for App Runner.

methods.name: createObservabilityConfiguration
methods.description: Creates an observability configuration for App Runner.

methods.name: createService
methods.description: Creates a new App Runner service.

methods.name: createVpcConnector
methods.description: Creates a VPC connector for App Runner.

methods.name: describeCustomDomains
methods.description: Describes custom domains associated with an App Runner service.

methods.name: disassociateCustomDomain
methods.description: Removes a custom domain from an App Runner service.

methods.name: listServicesForAutoScalingConfiguration
methods.description: Lists services associated with a specific auto scaling configuration.

methods.name: resumeService
methods.description: Resumes a paused App Runner service.

methods.name: startDeployment
methods.description: Starts a deployment for a service.

methods.name: updateDefaultAutoScalingConfiguration
methods.description: Updates the default auto scaling configuration.

methods.name: updateService
methods.description: Updates an existing App Runner service.
